purpose: Teach the Survivor.io optimizer to evaluate all possible spend choices using the same kind of data model used by sIO Tools, instead of hardcoded opinions.
status: initial reverse-engineering map from uploaded bundled site code

important_correction_from_user.relic_cores_45: already used inside current build; do not treat as free/spendable
important_correction_from_user.movable_awakening_core_rule: only awakening cores that can be pulled out from other Xeno pet awakening stars are movable
important_correction_from_user.optimizer_goal: compare all valid possibilities together and pick best damage output, not split lanes or force relic cores

data_module_contains: items with stats and af/e/v/c trees
techs with rarity, deployedRarity, resonance, deployedResonance, overload, collectibles, sets

formula_map.stat_aggregation_pattern: Start with base stats, then add contributions from gear, AF E/V/C, heroes, collectibles, tech rarity, deployed tech effects, resonance breakpoints, pet stars, xeno awakening, pet skills, mounts, and mode settings.
formula_map.gear_pattern: Each equipment item has base stats plus af.e, af.v, and af.c trees. A candidate upgrade must produce a concrete final E/V/C state before it can be scored.
formula_map.tech_pattern: For each equipped tech and mode, add rarity stats, deployedRarity stats if deployed, resonance breakpoint stats, deployedResonance stats if deployed, overload stats, collectible/set stats, then compute CE/resonance multiplier for that tech mode.
formula_map.xeno_pet_awakening_pattern: xenoPetAwakening is an ordered array. For each awakening row, count how many Xeno pets have stars greater than that row index, then add values[count] to the row stat.
formula_map.xeno_pet_resonance_formula: xenoResMultiplier = clamp(xenoResChance + lme.xenoResChance, 0, 100) * max(0, xenoResDamage + lme.xenoResDamage) * (4 + clamp(xenoResDuration + lme.xenoResDuration, 0, ?)) / 500
formula_map.optimizer_training_rule: Generate all legal spend allocations first, simulate resulting build state, evaluate damage using extracted formula/data, then rank by marginal damage per limited resource. Never pre-split by lane or force a preferred item.

input_state: choice consumables and their possible outputs
choice_space: Core Chest: Awakening Core OR Xeno Pet Core OR Relic Core OR Resonance Chip
Relic Core Chest: Relic Core OR S-grade Excellent Choice Pack
Legend Collectible + Resonance Chip Choice Chest: Epic Quality Tech Choice Chest x2 OR Legend Collectible Choice Pack OR Resonance Chip
S-grade Excellent Choice Pack: exact S equipment family/slot selector
Voidwalker Supply Crate: exact Voidwaker family/slot selector
Tech Core Choice Chest: Eternal/Void/Chaos Tech Core selector
output_needed: plain total end items to pick/buy
which source item each output came from
score and reason based on simulated damage, not opinion

training_case_schema.plain_output: ITEM xN -> PICK Y -> END ITEM Z -> FINAL STATE
